title: Racial and Ethnic Distribution in Sarasota County, Florida
text:
Sarasota County, Florida, shows distinctive geographic patterns across racial and ethnic groups. While White residents make up the majority across most census tracts, minority communities are concentrated in distinct areas—such as the historic Black community of Newtown (Tract 3) in North Sarasota and growing Hispanic communities in central and southern sections of the county.










Key Takeaways

White: Forms a high percentage of the population across almost all coastal, suburban, and rural tracts.
Hispanic: Clusters primarily in urban and suburban corridors with tracts reaching 30–38% Hispanic.
Black: Strongly concentrated in North Sarasota (Newtown, Tract 3 reaches 74.5%), while remaining below 3% in most other tracts.
Asian: Represents a smaller proportion countywide (typically 1–3%), with subtle pockets in suburban neighborhoods.
